source_instruction: what deodorants do you have that are alcohol free and very long lasting?
query: Ugh, I swear the squirrel that keeps raiding my bird feeder got into the pantry last night and chewed through half the bag of my favorite salted caramel granola bars, I had to chase it around the kitchen for ten minutes before it bolted out the back screen door I forgot to latch, and now I’m running late to meet my friend for a walk around the lake where the geese have been super aggressive lately hissing at anyone who gets too close to their goslings. Anyway, I need to pick up an alcohol free, long lasting deodorant from the deodorants & antiperspirants section, and stick to that one for the price cap, yeah?
